scope: Producer-originated logical read-issue descriptor and channel factory. No live candidate, R2 arbitration, R1 request, payload response deposit, source service, GQA, R4, scoreboard event emission, physical-memory, timing, throughput, PPA, model/GPU, numeric RTL, or new A4 DSE behavior.

fields.name: candidate_class
fields.rule: R2 retains arbitration and rotation ownership

fields.name: transaction_identity
fields.rule: never allocated or reconstructed by endpoint

fields.name: source_kind
fields.rule: hot is illegal for a core-memory read

fields.name: destination_endpoint
fields.rule: must agree with immutable target descriptor

fields.name: expected_fragment_count
fields.source: producer request fact captured by RTL2.2.4

fields.name: target_descriptor
fields.rule: retains PageRef and requires_sidecar without choosing sidecar mapping

scoreboard.rule: A planning-only read_issue observation cannot substitute for R1 acceptance or typed fragment delivery.

required_invariants: The top does not construct a read-issue descriptor.
Only named source fact owners provide handle, valid_count, identity, and generation facts.
R2 remains sole owner of arbitration, credits, FIFO order, rotation, and grant-on-R1-accept.
Endpoints never reconstruct a descriptor field from an R1 response.
requires_sidecar plus PageRef preserve obligation without selecting a sidecar address mapping or transport sequence.
No source deliverability or authority transition follows from descriptor presence.
